articles.title: Understanding OOTDBuy tracking when a parcel is out for delivery
articles.description: OOTDBUY's help navigation includes tracking and out-for-delivery topics.

sections.heading: Read the event in its carrier context
paragraphs: OOTDBUY's help navigation includes tracking and out-for-delivery topics. Use the international parcel number from your account and identify the carrier that produced the latest scan. A delivery-route event usually describes the carrier's next operational step. It does not establish that the recipient has already received the box or that every package in a multi-box shipment is at the same stage.

sections.heading: Check the address and delivery options
paragraphs: Compare the delivery information in your parcel confirmation with the carrier record where available. Look for details that matter locally, such as an apartment number, business reception desk or designated pickup location. If the carrier offers delivery instructions, use its official channel and give information appropriate to that shipment. Avoid publishing your full address or tracking number to ask for general advice.

sections.heading: Follow an unsuccessful attempt
paragraphs: Read the complete attempt message. A request for pickup, an incomplete address and a scheduled redelivery call for different actions. Save the event text and timestamp, then look for a deadline or pickup instruction on the carrier's official page. If no next action is clear, contact the named carrier or OOTDBUY with the parcel reference and the exact message rather than relying on a generic delivery-time estimate.

sections.heading: Resolve a delivered scan carefully
paragraphs: Check the recorded delivery location and the appropriate reception or household contact before reporting a missing parcel. If it still cannot be located, retain the tracking history, delivery evidence offered by the carrier and parcel confirmation. Ask OOTDBUY what process and deadline applies to the route. For multiple cartons, identify the specific tracking number still missing so a delivered companion box does not close the wrong enquiry.

sections.heading: Check the handoff before contacting the delivery depot
paragraphs: A parcel number from the international agent may coexist with a different number used by the local delivery partner. Look in the parcel record for an explicitly named carrier or partner tracking reference. Follow the official carrier route for the local leg and retain the international number for the agent. If the two systems show different messages, compare the timestamps and full event descriptions. One may be a translated summary published later than the original carrier event.

A workplace address can complicate an apparently missing delivery. Ask the reception desk or mailroom about the correct day, carrier and recipient name without sharing the parcel number broadly. At an apartment, check the carrier's own delivery note for a locker or collection point. If the note indicates one, verify the official retrieval instructions and the time allowed. Do not rely on a separate payment or verification link arriving by unsolicited message.

sections.heading: Keep a structured record if a delivered parcel cannot be found
paragraphs: Write down when the carrier marked delivery, what location or evidence it supplied and who has already checked for the box. If the carrier provides a photograph, compare the surroundings with the actual entrance carefully. A familiar door color alone can be misleading. Contact the carrier or OOTDBUY through their official channels, give the tracking number and ask what enquiry process applies. Save the case reference and any reply. If the box later turns up, update the same enquiry so the search does not continue on an already resolved parcel.

sections.heading: Use the definition supplied by the named carrier
paragraphs: When an OOTDBUY tracking page reports that a parcel is out for delivery, identify the company underlying the event. UPS and FedEx both publish their own tracking explanations. Their descriptions can help you understand how a carrier distinguishes electronic notification, physical movement, a local delivery run and completed delivery. Read the terminology for the actual carrier and destination service. A translated event from a general tracking page may compress several different original messages into similar English phrases.

Look for the timestamp and time zone attached to the event. If a local carrier scanned the parcel early in the morning, the international tracking summary might not repeat it until later. A delayed update on the agent page does not automatically represent another physical scan. Preserve the local carrier's original description when asking OOTDBUY to interpret it. If a local reference has not been supplied, ask which channel to use instead of assuming a carrier based on a familiar tracking-number format.

sections.heading: Read the address as a delivery driver would
paragraphs: Check whether the recipient name is recognizable at the address, whether an apartment or suite number is present, and whether a business reception or mailroom commonly accepts deliveries. An address may look correct to a resident but lack a detail needed to distinguish two entrances or reception desks. If the carrier has a verified delivery-instructions feature, follow its official process and review exactly which reference the instruction affects. Avoid posting entrance codes, full addresses or private delivery photographs in public tracking discussions.

A workplace delivery can require a different follow-up from a residential one. At a large office building, a carrier may hand a carton to central receiving before it reaches an individual department. Provide reception with the expected recipient, date, carrier and parcel description sufficient to identify it. At a residential collection point, use the official pickup information and confirm any required identity check before travelling. If the carrier specifically says another attempt is planned, check the official next steps rather than assuming the recipient must collect it immediately.

sections.heading: Deal with delivered status and an unfamiliar photograph
paragraphs: Compare the carrier evidence with the actual entrance or reception area without drawing conclusions from one detail alone. A similar doormat might appear at several apartments, while a delivery photograph taken from an odd angle can obscure a familiar doorway. Ask the relevant household or reception contact and record what has been checked. If the parcel cannot be found, contact the appropriate carrier or OOTDBUY promptly with the exact reference and the recorded delivery event.

Keep a concise enquiry timeline including when you first saw the status, any delivery proof, who checked designated locations, and any carrier or agent case number. Ask who can open a formal investigation and which deadline applies to the actual line. If the recipient is different from the person who paid OOTDBUY, coordinate the response so both people refer to the same parcel and case. Avoid multiple inconsistent reports that make it appear several cartons are missing when the concern is with one delivery.

sections.heading: Recognize when the tracking problem has become a contents issue
paragraphs: Once the correct carton is located, compare its label and contents with the OOTDBUY parcel confirmation. A successful delivery scan establishes an event for the box and does not establish that every intended piece is inside. If one product is missing, retain the carton, packing and inventory list and compare them with warehouse photos. If several cartons were involved, check whether the missing product was assigned to another tracking number before opening a contents enquiry.

For damaged goods, document the condition as received and draw on OOTDBUY's receipt and damage guidance. For an intact box that was simply delivered later than the first out-for-delivery scan suggested, record the final outcome and close any open carrier enquiry. Keeping those outcomes separate gives a more accurate account of what happened. It also makes future delivery planning more useful: one scan from one carrier on one day can illustrate a process, while your next parcel will still depend on its own route, destination and service conditions.

sections.heading: Save the final-mile reference before the handoff disappears
paragraphs: When a message identifies a local partner or collection office, retain its actual tracking reference alongside the agent number. Some pickup instructions are easier to recover from the local carrier than from the international history. For a shared parcel, tell the person collecting it which official reference to use and what identity information the carrier says is required. Once collected, record the date and confirm the contents against the original packing record before discarding any labels you may need later.

faq.q: When is an OOTDBuy custom order useful?
faq.a: OOTDBUY offers Custom Order when you cannot find the item through the normal buying flow. Provide the seller link and exact variation so the agent can identify the offer.

faq.q: What should I include for a custom order with two versions?
faq.a: Copy the seller's option label, quantity and variant code. Add a photo that clearly identifies the chosen version and state whether substitutions are acceptable.

faq.q: I already paid the seller. Which OOTDBuy service should I check?
faq.a: Look at Forwarding Order for goods that you send to the agent's warehouse yourself. Confirm the current receiving and identification instructions before the seller dispatches anything.

faq.q: How do I register goods from a seller who used two domestic parcels?
faq.a: Keep both tracking numbers and a contents list for each. Ask how to associate each parcel with the forwarding record in your account.

faq.q: Is a full outfit included when the spreadsheet shows it in one photo?
faq.a: Read the selected seller option. A single listing may sell the top, the bottom or a bundle separately even when every image shows the whole outfit.

faq.q: How do I size a coordinated set with one shared size selector?
faq.a: Compare the seller's measurements for both garments with items you own. Verify both fit before buying a set that cannot be split into different sizes.

faq.q: What should stay the same when comparing OOTDBuy shipping options?
faq.a: Use the same destination, contents and package measurements. Check what each service includes before comparing the displayed amounts.

faq.q: Why might a shipping line disappear when I add another product?
faq.a: A line's acceptance rules can depend on contents, dimensions and destination. Ask which rule affects your parcel and keep the product description accurate.

faq.q: Does preserving a retail shoe box change the estimate?
faq.a: It can change the outer dimensions and packing requirements. Compare quotes for the actual two packing scenarios you are willing to accept.

faq.q: What should I photograph if two shoes have different labels?
faq.a: Keep a full-pair photo, readable labels from each shoe and the box label if relevant. Compare each against the original size system and selected option.

faq.q: What if my shoe labels match but the box label differs?
faq.a: Ask the agent to identify the packaging discrepancy and decide whether the original box is part of the purchase you need. Keep the pair separate from other unresolved orders.

faq.q: How can I track storage for items that arrived separately?
faq.a: Record the warehouse identifier and displayed deadline for each item. Plan from the earliest relevant deadline and confirm current options in the Storage help topic.

faq.q: Will extra warehouse storage preserve a seller return option?
faq.a: Check the seller aftersales deadline separately. An agreement to keep goods at the warehouse does not establish that the seller will still accept a return.

faq.q: Where is OOTDBuy's official return guidance?
faq.a: Open Returns and Refunds and How to apply for aftersales from the official help navigation, then check the applicable conditions for the specific order status.

faq.q: How do I explain a shortage when the seller sells packs?
faq.a: State the number of packs purchased, units per pack and number actually counted. Include the selected offer and photos that distinguish sealed packages from individual pieces.

faq.q: What should I keep if a fragile item arrives broken?
faq.a: Keep the carton, shipping label, protective material and original photos. Follow the current receipt and fragile-damage guidance for the applicable route.

faq.q: Does a damaged retail box count the same as damage to the item?
faq.a: Describe each separately. Document the product condition, retail packaging and outer carton so the applicable service or claim process can be checked.

faq.q: Where do I check whether OOTDBuy credited a top-up?
faq.a: Compare the payment provider's confirmation with the account balance history. Match currency, amount, time and transaction reference before trying another payment.

faq.q: How do I distinguish a wallet correction from a card refund?
faq.a: Check where support says the money was sent. Look for a ledger entry in the wallet or a refund reference for the payment provider, according to the stated resolution.

faq.q: What can I do after an unsuccessful delivery attempt?
faq.a: Read the carrier's exact message and check for official pickup or redelivery instructions. Retain the parcel reference and contact OOTDBUY if the next step is unclear.

faq.q: What should I report when only one carton from a shipment arrives?
faq.a: Identify the missing carton's tracking number, last scan and expected contents. State which companion carton arrived so support can investigate the correct parcel.
